bets.what: Build and ship the playtest feedback sorter
bets.hypothesis: The sorter removes the feedback-overload pain, converting free beta users: Paying customers rise from 2 to 4 — it also tests the 'non-survivable flaw' the Evaluation flags.

bets.what: Post in the BGG design forum twice a week
bets.hypothesis: Consistent presence where indie designers gather drives signups: Beta users grow from 12 to 20.

bets.what: Run a free trial week for the ten unpaid beta users
bets.hypothesis: Giving unpaid beta users a free trial week of the full kit convinces at least one to convert, moving Paying customers from 2 to 3.

result.note: Nobody new paid. Three of the ten used the trial and all three said the same: they print one prototype and stop, so a month feels wrong. Price per project next.
